entries.title: II Chronicles 32:1
segments: After these things done in faithfulness, Sennacherib, the king of Assyria, came and entered into Judah, and camped against the fortified cities, and commanded to break them open to himself.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:2
segments: And when Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib had come, and that he [had set] his face to fight against Jerusalem,

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:3
segments: he took counsel with his rulers and his mighty men to stop the waters of the fountains outside the city. And they helped him.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:4
segments: And there were gathered many people, who stopped all the fountains, and the torrent which ran through the midst of the land, saying, Why should the king of Assyria come and find much water?

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:5
segments: And he made himself strong and built up all the wall that was broken, and raised [it] up to the towers, and another wall outside, and repaired Millo in the city of David, and made darts and shields in abundance.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:6
segments: And he set commanders of war over the people and gathered them to himself in the street of the gate of the city. And he spoke to their heart, saying,

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:7
segments: Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid nor dismayed because of the king of Assyria, or for all the multitude with him. For [there are] more with us than with him.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:8
segments: With him [is] an arm of flesh, but with us [is] the LORD our God to help us and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves on the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:9
segments: After this Sennacherib king of Assyria sent his servants to Jerusalem; and he [was] against Lachish, and all his forces with him against Hezekiah king of Judah, and against all Judah in Jerusalem, saying,

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:10
segments: Sennacherib king of Assyria says this, On what do you trust that you sit under siege in Jerusalem?

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:11
segments: Does not Hezekiah persuade you to give yourselves over to die by famine and by thirst, saying, Jehovah our God shall deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:12
segments: Has not the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars, and commanded Judah and Jerusalem, saying, You shall worship before one altar and burn incense on it?

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:13
segments: Do you not know what I and my fathers have done to all the people of other lands? Were the gods of the nations of those lands in any way able to deliver their lands out of my hands?

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:14
segments: Who among all the gods of those nations that my fathers completely destroyed [is] able to deliver his people out of my hand, that your God should be able to deliver you out of my hand?

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:15
segments: And now do not let Hezekiah deceive you or persuade you in this way, nor yet believe him. For no god of any nation was able to deliver his people out of my hand, and out of the hand of my fathers. How much less shall your god deliver you out of my hand?

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:16
segments: And his servants spoke still [more] against the LORD God, and against His servant Hezekiah.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:17
segments: He also wrote letters to revile the LORD God of Israel, and to speak against Him, saying, As the gods of the nations of [other] lands have not delivered their people out of my hand, so shall not the God of Hezekiah deliver His people out of my hand.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:18
segments: And they cried out with a loud voice [in] Jewish to the people of Jerusalem on the wall, in order to frighten them and to trouble them, so that they might take the city.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:19
segments: And they spoke against the God of Jerusalem, as against the gods of the peoples of the earth, the work of the hands of man.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:20
segments: And for this [reason] Hezekiah the king and the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz prayed and cried to Heaven.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:21
segments: And the LORD sent an angel to cut off all the mighty men of power, and the leaders and commanders in the camp of the king of Assyria. And he returned with shame of face to his own land. And he came into the house of his god, and those from his own bowels killed him there with the sword.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:22
segments: And the LORD saved Hezekiah and the people of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria, and from the hand of all [others], and guided them on every side.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:23
segments: And many brought gifts to the LORD to Jerusalem, and presents to Hezekiah king of Judah, so that he was magnified in the sight of all nations from that time on.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:24
segments: In those days Hezekiah was sick to death, and prayed to the LORD. And He spoke to him, and He gave him a sign.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:25
segments: But Hezekiah did not give again according to the good [done] to him, for his heart was lifted up. And there was wrath on him and on Judah and Jerusalem.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:26
segments: And Hezekiah was humbled for the pride of his heart, he and the people of Jerusalem, so that the wrath of the LORD did not come on them in the days of Hezekiah.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:27
segments: And Hezekiah had exceedingly much riches and honor. And he made himself treasuries for silver, and for gold, and for precious stones, and for spices, and for shields, and for all kinds of pleasant jewels.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:28
segments: And he made storehouses for the increase of grain and wine and oil, and stalls for all kinds of animals, and stalls for flocks.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:29
segments: And he provided himself cities, and possessions of flocks and herds, in abundance. For God had given him very many things.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:30
segments: And Hezekiah himself stopped the upper water courses of Gihon, and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David. And Hezekiah was blessed in all his works.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:31
segments: But, in [regard to] the ambassadors of the rulers of Babylon who sent to him to ask about the wonder that was done in the land, God left him in order to try him, to know all that was in his heart.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:32
segments: And the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and his goodness, behold, they [are] written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, and in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:33
segments: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the highest of the tombs of the sons of David. And all Judah and the people of Jerusalem honored him at his death. And his son Manasseh reigned in his place.
